summary.text: Matt Day (legal name Benjamin Matthew Day) is the Republican nominee for Georgia's 2nd Congressional District. He is a business owner from Douglas, Georgia, with a background in the glazing and construction industries, and this is his first run for office. The Atlanta Journal-Constitution reports he calls himself a commonsense conservative.

paragraphs.text: Is from Douglas, Georgia, and is described by the Atlanta Journal-Constitution as a business owner.

According to Branch, he launched Glaziers on Demand in 2013, which supplied glass installation crews to sites in more than 40 states, and founded Glazier Nation in 2019, a staffing service for electricians, welders and crane operators on large construction projects.

Branch lists him as founder and owner of ChoreNab since 2025, a company applying an on-demand labor model to U.S. manufacturing plants; his campaign website lists glazing, construction and software development among his experience.
Has not held elected office; Branch describes this campaign as his first entry into politics. He was unopposed in the May 19, 2026 Republican primary, per Ballotpedia.
